title: Lift algebra operations on an algebraized finite module system
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated and finite type. Write $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ and $j_n:X_n\to X$. Let $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ be the canonical transition immersion, specified by both pullback projection equations. Let $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ be the canonical composition comparison of tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $p_n:Y_n\to X_n$ be finite, with $g_n:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ giving cartesian transition squares and $j_{n+1}\circ p_{n+1}\circ g_n=j_n\circ p_n$. Let $G$ be a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent] on $X$ with support proper over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and suppose isomorphisms $\psi_n:j_n^*G\cong p_{n,*}\mathcal O_{Y_n}$ commute with $c_n$ and the canonical affine base-change maps followed by the structure-sheaf pullback maps [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change]. Then there is a commutative algebra sheaf $B$ [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf] with an isomorphism of its underlying module to $G$, and algebra maps $b_n:B\to(j_n\circ p_n)_*\mathcal O_{Y_n}$ commuting with $g_n$ on every open of $X$. For every affine open $U\subset X$, if $J_n(U)=\ker(j_n^\sharp(U))$, there is a ring equivalence $B(U)/J_n(U)B(U)\cong\mathcal O_{Y_n}((j_n\circ p_n)^{-1}U)$ sending the class of $x$ to $b_n(U)(x)$.

source.place: Lemma 09ZT (lemma-algebraize-formal-scheme-finite-over-proper), multiplication paragraph, expanded using 088E and 088F; source read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09ZT

proof.text: Lift algebra operations and compatible adjoint maps, obtaining B, e, b, their section formula and transition compatibility. This is the operations-only part of the source; it does not supply quotient sections.

X is Noetherian by finite type over A. Coherence gives quasi-coherence of G, which transports across e to B.toModule. For each n the canonical thickening j_n is a closed immersion (surjective quotient spectrum and pullback stability). Compose pullback of e with psi_n and use the adjoint section formula to apply the single-closed-immersion affine exactness theorem. It gives surjectivity and the exact kernel ideal.

For each affine open, compose Ideal.quotEquivOfEq for the kernel equality with RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective. The two quotient representative formulas give the requested formula. Package this family with e and b and retain the transition equality from the operations lemma.

theorem finite_structure_algebra_lift
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
      pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I :=
      I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c n = (Classical.choice (Scheme.Modules.nonempty_tensorPullbackComp (i n)
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 +
      1)))))))).symm ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (hi n)))
    (Yn : ℕ → Scheme.{u})
    (fnY : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    [∀ n, IsFinite (fnY n)]
    (gn : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ Yn (n + 1))
    (hcart : ∀ n, IsPullback (fnY n) (gn n) (i n) (fnY (n + 1)))
    (hw : ∀ n, gn n ≫ (fnY (n + 1) ≫ pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) =
      fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (hproper : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f G)
    (ψ : ∀ n, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn n).ringCatSheaf))
    (hψ : ∀ n,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (ψ (n + 1)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (fnY (n + 1)) (fnY n) (i n) (gn n)
          (hcart n).flip.w (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn (n + 1)).ringCatSheaf) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).map
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (gn n))) =
        (c n).hom.app G ≫ (ψ n).hom) :
    ∃ B : X.CommAlgebraSheaf, Nonempty (B.toModule ≅ G) ∧
      ∃ b : ∀ n, B ⟶ 𝒪⁎(fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))),
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen U →
          ∃ e : (B.right.obj.obj (op U) ⧸
              (RingHom.ker ((pullback.fst f
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).app U).hom).map
                (B.hom.hom.app (op U)).hom) ≃+*
              Γ(Yn n, (fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ⁻¹ᵁ U),
            ∀ x, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = ((b n).right.hom.app (op U)).hom x) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
          (b (n + 1)).right.hom.app (op U) ≫
            (gn n).appLE ((fnY (n + 1) ≫ pullback.fst f
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
              ((fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
              (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hw n]) =
            (b n).right.hom.app (op U))
